author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: RFC3986 segment encoding is duplicated in the route instead of using the existing reader source-info encoder.
findings.consequence: The canonical path encoding policy can drift between source-info validation/projection and this resolver; future changes to escaping or scalar handling would need to be found and updated in multiple places.
findings.evidence: The owned unit defines a local encoder at lines 7-12. The direct dependency server/utils/reader-source-info-validation.ts already exports encodeReaderSourceSegment with the same RFC3986 escaping behavior, and app/lib/internal-navigation.ts also owns a canonical segment encoder used by direct consumer routes.
findings.recommendation: Import and use the existing source-info segment encoder from server/utils/reader-source-info-validation.ts, or move the shared server/app route segment encoder behind one explicit utility boundary if this resolver must share the app canonical encoding policy.
